title: RTX 5060 Ti 16GB vs Modern Games at 4K [Ray Tracing, DLSS, Frame Gen]
description:

See real-world benchmarks and find out if the RTX 5060 Ti delivers a smooth, next-gen experience at this demanding resolution!
